# Paperclip Guided Evidence Synthesis

This workflow has exactly three user-visible stages: **Question**,
**Evidence**, and **Results**. The numbered phase files are modular internal
subroutines used by Claude; they are not extra user stages.

Claude owns orchestration. At every checkpoint, summarize the decision in
plain language and use `AskUserQuestion`. A successful extraction or QA run
is never user approval.

## Remote loading contract

This orchestrator is loaded into context by
`paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis`. Do not look for installed
local SKILL.md files. Before each internal subroutine, run the exact
`paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/<file>` command below
and follow the returned phase instructions. Load phases sequentially and only
when the current stage requires them.

## Context preservation and recovery

Do not voluntarily invoke context compaction (`/compact`) or discard this
routine; automatic compaction remains possible.

After compaction or uncertainty:

1. **HARD STOP:** take no workflow action and edit no artifact.
2. Find `<topic_dir>`. If unknown, search workspace for
   `analysis_project.json`; never replace lost context with `start`. Ask the
   user if multiple projects match.
3. Reload this orchestrator with `paperclip routines show
   paperclip-meta-analysis`, then run `paperclip routines run
   paperclip-meta-analysis resume --dir <topic_dir> --json` followed by
   `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis status --dir <topic_dir>
   --json`.
4. Trust `stage`, `status`, `approvals`, `next_action`, and files on disk—not
   the conversation summary. Resume the earliest incomplete requirement:
   - **Question:** replay Stage 1 in order; all five drafts precede approval.
   - **Evidence:** incomplete search/extraction returns to Phases 3–5; missing
     or invalid `verified_findings.json` returns to Phase 6; missing
     `evidence_proposal.json`, `harmonization_map.json`, or
     `evidence_review.json` returns to Phase 8. Awaiting-user status means
     present the Evidence checkpoint and stop. Never load Phase 7.
   - **Results:** run `validate-results`; invalid results return to Phase 7,
     missing synthesis/PRISMA to Phase 9, and incomplete report/QA to Phases
     10–11. Phase 12 requires an explicit publish choice.
5. Fetch the selected phase with `paperclip routines show
   paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/<file>` and recheck its preconditions.

### Intentional change and resume playbooks

Use these private commands exactly; never substitute direct state/hash edits.

**Protocol changed:** run `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis
revise question --dir <topic_dir> --json`. Edit `protocol_draft.json` and any
affected draft contracts only—never approved `protocol.json`. Repeat Question
review, run `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis approve-question
--dir <topic_dir> --json`, rerun the representative pilot, then bind its passing
summary with `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis pilot-complete
--summary <topic_dir>/pilot_summary.json --dir <topic_dir> --json`. Rerun
affected extraction/verification, then run `paperclip routines run
paperclip-meta-analysis export-verified --dir <topic_dir>` and `paperclip
routines run paperclip-meta-analysis review evidence --refresh --dir
<topic_dir> --json`. After explicit Evidence approval run `paperclip routines
run paperclip-meta-analysis analyze --dir <topic_dir> --json`, followed by
`paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis analysis-run --dir <topic_dir>
--json` to recreate the Results binding.

**Search-only Evidence changed:** run `paperclip routines run
paperclip-meta-analysis revise evidence --dir <topic_dir> --json`. Leave
`protocol.json` and `protocol_draft.json` unchanged; update logged retrieval,
rerun affected search/screen/extraction/verification, then run `paperclip
routines run paperclip-meta-analysis export-verified --dir <topic_dir>` and
`paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis review evidence --refresh
--dir <topic_dir> --json`. After explicit approval run `paperclip routines run
paperclip-meta-analysis analyze --dir <topic_dir> --json`, then `paperclip
routines run paperclip-meta-analysis analysis-run --dir <topic_dir> --json`;
the latter recreates the Results binding.

**Results changed:** run `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis revise
results --reason "<reason>" --dir <topic_dir> --json` before editing. It
archives the current `revisions/results-vN/` and increments the Results revision,
so any later publication uses the new version. Report-only edits preserve
frozen Evidence and valid execution; method/code edits rerun `analysis-run`.
Always rerun applicable data/render QA and user review.

**Resume:** run `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis resume --dir
<topic_dir> --json`, then `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis
status --dir <topic_dir> --json`. Resume selects the existing project and
recomputes its stage-sensitive `next_action`; it does not grant approval or
authorize skipping the earliest incomplete requirement.

Never choose a phase from a conversation summary alone.

## Stage 1 — Question

Run these internal subroutines:

1. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-01-decomposition`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-01-decomposition.md`)
2. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-02-protocol-viability`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-02-protocol-viability.md`)
3. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-02-schema-discovery`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-02-schema-discovery.md`)

Each phase writes mandatory files to `<topic_dir>`. Schema discovery uses
`map` with a natural language extraction prompt; Claude merges the mapped
observations into a project-specific proposal and never claims that pilot
categories are comprehensive.

**Before calling `approve-question`, ALL of the following must exist on disk
in `<topic_dir>`:**

- `protocol_draft.json`
- `source_readiness.json`
- `schema_discovery.json`
- `collection_spec.json`
- `planned_outputs.json`

The gate rejects approval if any file is missing. In-context reasoning does
not substitute for writing these files. Complete each phase's file writes
before moving to the next phase.

> **CHECKPOINT — ASK THE USER:** Present the proposed question, scope, source
> readiness, collection categories/fields, planned analyses/visualizations,
> bounded/open/hybrid vocabulary choices, important exclusions, and unresolved
> normalization choices. Use `AskUserQuestion` with plain-language choices to
> approve, request changes, or stop. Remain in Question until the user
> explicitly approves. Claude then records approval privately and materializes
> canonical `protocol.json` with `paperclip routines run
> paperclip-meta-analysis approve-question --dir <topic_dir> --json`.

## Stage 2 — Evidence

After Question approval, run these internal subroutines in this order:

1. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-03-extraction-guidance`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-03-extraction-guidance.md`)
2. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-04-search`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-04-search.md`)
3. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-05-screening-extraction`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-05-screening-extraction.md`)
4. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-06-verification-gate`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-06-verification-gate.md`)
5. variance/precision and coverage audit
6. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-08-harmonization`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-08-harmonization.md`)
7. deterministic `evidence_review.json` refresh

Evidence starts with an adaptive small, diverse pilot—usually 3–8 papers, but
the approved protocol, source diversity, and deliverable determine the actual
size. Present material ambiguities and schema revisions to the user, apply only
user-approved changes, and rerun the pilot until it passes. After the pilot,
present the extraction plan and field definitions. Use `AskUserQuestion` to
approve, revise, or stop. Only then launch extraction across the full candidate
set.

Extraction uses standard `paperclip map --from <search_id>` with a
structured prompt. Each paper's output is added to a repo with
`paperclip repo add` and verified with `paperclip repo commit`.

Only exact values in readable text, readable tables, or text supplements are
eligible as verified source findings. Values visible only in figures, plots,
or image tables are excluded from the verified repo.

> **CHECKPOINT — ASK THE USER:** Present `evidence_review.json`, including
> coverage, exclusions, unresolved questions, visual-evidence gaps,
> harmonization decisions, and analysis/visualization readiness. Use
> `AskUserQuestion` with plain-language choices to revise Evidence, proceed to
> Results, or stop. Do not generate analysis merely because Evidence gates
> pass. Claude opens Results privately only after an explicit user choice.

## Stage 3 — Results

After the user approves analysis:

1. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-07-statistical-analysis`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-07-statistical-analysis.md`) — generate and
   execute a package-backed analysis tailored to approved Evidence
2. validate execution and result contracts
3. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-09-synthesis`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-09-synthesis.md`)
4. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-10-output`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-10-output.md`)
5. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/quality-gates`
   (remote file: `phases/quality-gates.md`)
6. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-11-render`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-11-render.md`) — iterative agent-authored report
   (`phases/html-style-reference.md` for styling, chart patterns, and
   manuscript structure — read before authoring HTML)
7. `paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/phase-12-persist`
   (remote file: `phases/phase-12-persist.md`) — explicit versioned publication

Examples are optional and example-only; they are never the default analysis or
correctness contract. Passing data/render QA means the current revision is
ready for review, not approved and not uploaded. Claude previews the report,
uses `AskUserQuestion`, archives each requested Results revision before
editing, and repeats authoring/QA/preview until the user accepts it.

> **CHECKPOINT — ASK THE USER:** Offer plain-language choices to revise the
> report, reopen Evidence, stop, or publish. Publication occurs only after an
> explicit publish choice and always targets a new immutable
> `analyses/<slug>/v<results_revision>` path. Preview and QA never upload.

## Non-negotiable invariants

- The paper repo remains the source of truth for verified source-backed cards.
- Every extracted value has its own source path/lines. All retained repo claims
  are stable-ID, exact-location, and fully resolved.
- `[!]` is an infrastructure error: retry verification and never remove a claim
  or paper because of it. Remove only a conclusively rejected `[X]` claim;
  retain its paper unless the paper independently fails protocol eligibility.
- A repo with papers but zero structured claims is a blocking failure. Persist
  and reconcile every extracted finding before verification.
- Open-world products/outcomes/assays/cohorts preserve `as_reported` wording and
  are not forced into a supposedly comprehensive enum.
- `verified_findings.json` comes only from the universal exporter, carries its
  generator marker, and is never created or edited by Claude.
- Reviewer/Claude assessments retain judgment provenance and are not presented
  as source-reported facts.
- Harmonization and Evidence review finish before any generated analysis.
- Claude generates `evidence_review.json` only with
  `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis review evidence --refresh
  --dir <topic_dir> --json`; it is never handwritten.
- Reopening Evidence invalidates downstream execution; report-only revision
  does not.
- No automatic stage transition and no automatic upload.

Start with
`paperclip routines show paperclip-meta-analysis/phases/00-overview`.
